pulls.title: Fix draft errors and inconsistencies
pulls.author: npmccallum
pulls.body:
Fix the CBOR reference, example errors, and inconsistencies in the existing rules. This also clarifies negative-index wording and fixes table formatting warnings.

Each issue has a separate commit explaining the rationale.

Checked with `make` (text and HTML) and an independent CBOR encoding check for the byte-string example.

pulls.title: Clarify pointer evaluation and complete the draft
pulls.author: npmccallum
pulls.body:
This builds on #1 with clearer evaluation and error handling, rules for embedded CBOR and map-key comparison, and security and IANA sections. It also removes array filters to keep searching separate from addressing, and adds Nathaniel McCallum as a co-author.

Each issue has a separate commit explaining the rationale. Sequence semantics and canonicalization are left for later discussion.

The text and HTML drafts build successfully.

#1 should merge first. [Changes after #1](https://github.com/npmccallum/cbor-pointer/compare/2403750c62c25e832ba1311975b8cca8dcc0a5fb...0556229).
